description: The four account identifiers (CURRENT_ORGANIZATION_NAME / CURRENT_ACCOUNT_NAME / CURRENT_ACCOUNT the locator / CURRENT_REGION) are answered upper-cased and genuinely distinct: the region is BARE by default (no region-group prefix), SHOW ACCOUNTS reports the same identity the functions answer, both account listings carry the measured 24-column shape (no invented region_group / org_default_region columns), and an absent old URL is the empty string with null moments beside it. Converted 1:1 from features/AccountIdentityTest (trimmed: the AccountIdentity/EngineConfig constructor tests - URL building and the configured region-group prefix - are Java-API-only and stay).

steps.sql: SELECT CURRENT_ORGANIZATION_NAME() IS NOT NULL, CURRENT_ORGANIZATION_NAME() = UPPER(CURRENT_ORGANIZATION_NAME())
SELECT CURRENT_ACCOUNT() IS NOT NULL, CURRENT_ACCOUNT() = UPPER(CURRENT_ACCOUNT())
SELECT CURRENT_ACCOUNT_NAME() IS NOT NULL, CURRENT_ACCOUNT_NAME() = UPPER(CURRENT_ACCOUNT_NAME())
SELECT CURRENT_REGION() IS NOT NULL, CURRENT_REGION() = UPPER(CURRENT_REGION())

SELECT "organization_name" = CURRENT_ORGANIZATION_NAME(), "account_name" = CURRENT_ACCOUNT_NAME(), "account_locator" = CURRENT_ACCOUNT(), "snowflake_region" = CURRENT_REGION() FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))

skip.reason: a real account's old-URL history is its own, not something a test may assert

steps.sql: SELECT '<' || "old_account_url" || '>', "account_old_url_saved_on" IS NULL, "organization_old_url_last_used" IS NULL FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
